title: route_next (MCP tool contract, draft v0.2)
description: Routing logic is owned by teammates; the evaluation harness only calls this tool, once per policy, to compare policies (E06). v0.2: validation_results is typed as validate_submission results; added contract_version, task_id of the attempt, and an explicit LESSON_COMPLETE value.

last_task_id.description: Task the validation_results belong to; null before the first task.

validation_results.description: The results[] array from the latest validate_submission call. Empty when validation failed; the router must then return fallback=true.

next_task_id.description: A task ID, or LESSON_COMPLETE when the lesson goal is met.

policy.description: Policy actually used. Differs from input.policy when fallback is true.

stance.description: Optional; Stance Decider 2B output in PROJECT_SPEC.md.

fallback.description: true when the non-adaptive authored order was used because validation or routing failed.
